symptom: ako/mxcli#2028: after `marketplace install` of the Agents Kit stack, mx check reported 0 errors but run/test --local failed compiling Java actions with ~180 `package io.modelcontextprotocol... does not exist`. Reproduced: MCP Client 4.4.0 into a fresh 11.12.6 app, `sync-java-deps --check` 3 of 3 missing; after a manual sync it still reported jackson-databind:[2.21.2,3) missing with jackson-databind-2.23.0.jar in vendorlib/.
cause: The install transplanted the ModuleSettings JarDependencies but never ran the resolution Studio Pro runs on import; UnvendoredJarDependencies looked for a file named after a Maven range; one transient 'Failed to find some hosts' ended the sync.
file: cmd/mxcli/marketplace_javadeps.go (syncInstalledJarDependencies after install/update), cmd/mxcli/docker/javadeps.go (jarVendored range match, retry on unreachable hosts)
insight: A declared dependency's version is not always a file name: Maven ranges resolve to whatever Gradle picks, so a vendored-check must match the artifact and test the range — the exact-name check made a correct sync fail its own postcondition. Reproduce with the real package (marketplace install with MENDIX_PAT into a `mxcli new` app at the cached mxbuild version), not a hand-made .mpk.
